ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   B. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   C. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Saum has no place in daily life.

   B. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   B. Cheating in exams
